interface.name: molang-refactor-supervisor
interface.purpose: Coordinate eyelib `molang` package refactor slices through subagent design, implementation, review, roadmap alignment, and Gradle verification without directly editing business logic.

triggers.text: supervising `io.github.tt432.eyelib.molang` package refactor work that must be split into reviewable subagent tasks

rules.predicate: Read `docs/molang/ROADMAP.md`, `docs/molang/refactor-plan/README.md`, the relevant phase plan, and `MODULES.md` before assigning a slice.
Split work into design, implementation, and review subtasks; use separate fresh subagents.

Revive the ANTLR path when refactoring (ANTLR generated code was fully removed on 2026-06-09, ADR-0004 Superseded; the handwritten recursive-descent parser under `src/main/java/io/github/tt432/eyelib/molang/compiler/` is the only frontend).
Require tests before implementation when semantics change, and require `mcmcp_test` for phase 1-4 slices.
rules.guard: when semantics change / for phase 1-4 slices
when phase status, gates, evidence, ownership, or verification posture changes

rules.predicate: Edit the corresponding `package-info.java` (e.g. `src/main/java/io/github/tt432/eyelib/molang/package-info.java`), then run `:generateModulesMd` to regenerate `MODULES.md`.
Each subagent task should include affected paths, pass/fail acceptance criteria, must-not-touch paths, verification commands, and documentation impact.

workflow.action: Read roadmap, refactor-plan README, relevant phase plan, and MODULES.md before assigning a slice
Split work into design, implementation, and review subtasks assigned to separate fresh subagents
Require tests before implementation when semantics change; require mcmcp_test for phase 1-4 slices
Update ROADMAP.md in the same slice on posture changes; on module responsibility changes edit package-info.java and run :generateModulesMd to regenerate MODULES.md
Shape each subagent handoff with affected paths, acceptance criteria, must-not-touch paths, verification commands, and documentation impact

termination: all assigned refactor slices verified and documented
